summary: Iter14: validated PER-MERCHANT UNIQUE 4-digit OTPs end-to-end. Backend: all 12 pytest in test_multi_merchant_orders.py PASS (covers create-generates-distinct-otps, accept-returns-only-my-otp, merchant_orders hides other merchant otp, per-merchant slice cancel, twilio inbound matches per-merchant otp, plus prior 7 state-machine tests). Phase1 single-store regression: 5/5 PASS. Frontend E2E (multi-store order BFO-8A76279A, A=5459, B=9834): (1) Customer /orders/:id shows BOTH per-store OTP cards (5459 inside MMUI A MiniStepper, 9834 inside MMUI B MiniStepper), global OtpCard correctly suppressed. (2) Admin Live orders tab shows MULTI-STORE pill + per-merchant slice rows with each unique OTP, Mark delivered + Cancel buttons PER slice. Single-store orders still show the original 'Cancel order' single-button layout. (3) Merchant A dashboard shows own OTP 5459 with subtotal ₹599 — NO leak of B's 9834. Merchant B dashboard shows own OTP 9834 with subtotal ₹1,198 — NO leak of A's 5459. All four agent_to_agent_context_note checkpoints verified.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderTracking.jsx correctly hides global OtpCard when is_multi_store and embeds per-store OTP inside each MiniStepper card only when state in {accepted,handed_off,delivered} — defensive against pending leak.
AdminPanel OrdersTab cleanly branches multi-store vs single-store rendering — preserves single-store UX while adding per-slice controls.
merchant_otps map response from GET /api/merchant/orders correctly filters to {mid:otp} for logged-in merchant only — strong server-side isolation, no other-merchant OTP leak even at JSON level.

POST /api/twilio/inbound scans the per-merchant merchant_otps dict and flips only the matching merchant's slice — not the first handed_off merchant. Verified by pytest test_twilio_inbound_matches_per_merchant_otp.
POST /api/admin/orders/{oid}/cancel {merchant_id, reason} correctly cancels just one slice; global flips to cancelled only when ALL slices cancelled. Verified.

rca of the issue: No issues found. Per-merchant unique OTP fan-out works end-to-end across backend, customer tracking, admin console and both merchant dashboards. Merchant-level OTP isolation verified — no cross-merchant OTP leakage at API or UI.
